item.title: MOTHERWELL v CELTIC: 5-MINUTE QUIZ
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY is aiming to complete a hat-trick of Premiership victories against Motherwell at Fir Park this evening. The Frenchman suffered four successive defeats after taking over from interim gaffer Martin O’Neill last month, but stopped the rot with back-to-back triumphs over Aberdeen (3-1) and Livingston (4-2). item.title: JIM CRAIG OBE
item.description: LISBON LION Jim Craig, 82, has been awarded an OBE in the New Year Honours List. The club ambassador, who was right-back in the team’s historic European Cup triumph over Inter Milan in the Portuguese capital on May 25 1967, has been recognised for his services to sport and charity. item.title: FERGUS McCANN CBE
item.description: FERGUS McCANN, the former Celtic chief executive, has been awarded a Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) for services to the economy and charity. The 84-year-old businessman and philanthropist, affectionately known as ‘The Bunnet’, led the 1994 takeover of the financially-stricken giants to revamp the club on and off the field. McCann [...]

item.title: PETER LAWWELL: PERSONAL VIEW BY ALEX GORDON
item.description: PETER LAWWELL officially ends a truly extraordinary 21-year association with Celtic today.
